otherConditions: GRE not required. Program prefers prerequisites be completed at a level required of a science major if not part of a science degree.

otherConditions: One semester of genetics must be completed by the application deadline (cannot be in progress). courses.name: Genetics

institution: University of Maryland School of Medicine
otherConditions: Beyond coursework, applicants must demonstrate crisis counseling experience (paid or volunteer) and shadowing/exposure with a genetic counselor or geneticist; laboratory/research experience is suggested but not mandatory.
